acceptance_criteria.criterion: composer test produces no deprecated-attribute warnings
composer test-suite -- Currencies runs only currency tests
composer test-suite -- Scanner runs scanner tests (may be 0 until WP-003)
All previously passing tests continue to pass

summary: Replaced phpunit.xml with modern PHPUnit 12.5 configuration: removed all deprecated attributes (backupGlobals, backupStaticAttributes, convertErrorsToExceptions, convertNoticesToExceptions, convertWarningsToExceptions, processIsolation).
Added per-directory test suites: Core, Countries, Currencies, Events, Locale, Parser, Scanner, TimeZones, Translator.
Removed single catch-all 'Application Localization Tests' suite that discovered all tests recursively.

comments.note: Added Scanner suite to phpunit.xml even though tests come in WP-003; the suite entry is required so the directory is recognized. Suite also added for future test discovery.
